answer: At the junction the signalman will not clear a train until the driver shows his logbook and the guard counts the vans, because a train that runs on borrowed papers meets trouble at the next station. Stationmaster ledger with railway company attestation is the logbook that settles the question: nine-year ledger, 4,200 trains despatched, signal inspections, annual audit. Present a forged pigment and the train is held, the driver pays the fare twice over, and the lagoon is seized as surety, while the umber is sent to the company office and read when the quarter ends.
